name: PHIL 3250W
title: Philosophy of Mind
description: Contemporary issues in the philosophy of mind. Topics may include the nature of the mental; the mind-body problem, the analysis of sensory experience, the problem of intentionality, and psychological explanation.
requirement_description: At least one 2000 level or above, three credit, philosophy course or consent of instructor; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011.
